summary: Tiziana Life Sciences filed a Form 6-K announcing the completion of patient enrollment in its Phase 2a clinical trial of intranasal foralumab for non-active secondary progressive multiple sclerosis. The press release provides operational progress (48 patients enrolled, topline expected late Q3 2026, presentation at ACTRIMS-ECTRIMS October 2026) but does not involve any corporate transaction, change of control, liquidity event, or activist activity. This is a routine business update for a biotech company, not a special situation.
